material.rule_uz: Siz mijozsiz, AI ofitsiant. U rolidan chiqmaydi: menyuni tushuntiradi, savol beradi, hisobni keltiradi. Siz buyurtma berasiz, so'raysiz va oxirigacha olib borasiz.
material.rule_ru: Вы — гость, ИИ — официант. Он не выходит из роли: объясняет меню, задаёт вопросы, приносит счёт. Вы заказываете, спрашиваете и доводите разговор до конца.
material.usage_uz: Vaziyat oson ketmaydi: so'ragan taomingiz tugagan bo'lishi mumkin yoki ofitsiant "katta yoki kichik?" deb qayta so'raydi. Bu ataylab — aynan shu paytda siz tayyor gapni emas, o'z gapingizni tuzasiz. Bir og'iz javob yetmaydi.
material.usage_ru: Ситуация не будет идти гладко: заказанного блюда может не оказаться, или официант переспросит «большой или маленький?». Так задумано — именно в этот момент вы строите свою фразу, а не воспроизводите готовую. Односложного ответа не хватит.

examples.en: Could I see the menu, please?
I'd like a large coffee and a sandwich.
Actually, I'd rather have tea.
Could we have the bill, please?

chunks.text: for here or to take away

questions.question_text: Imagine you just sat down in a cafe. Ask me for the menu.
questions.canonical_answer: Could I see the menu, please?
answer_variants: Can I have the menu, please?

questions.question_text: Order a drink and something to eat.
questions.canonical_answer: I'd like a large coffee and a cheese sandwich, please.
answer_variants: Can I have tea and a piece of cake?

questions.question_text: Imagine the dish you ordered is finished. Choose something else.
questions.canonical_answer: In that case I'd rather have the soup.
answer_variants: Then I'll take the chicken instead.

questions.question_text: Tell me you have an allergy and ask what is in the dish.
questions.canonical_answer: I'm allergic to nuts — could you tell me what is in it?
answer_variants: Does this have milk in it?

questions.question_text: Imagine the coffee is cold. Tell the waiter politely.
questions.canonical_answer: Sorry, this coffee is cold — could you change it?
answer_variants: Excuse me, my coffee isn't hot.

questions.question_text: Ask how long the food will take.
questions.canonical_answer: How long will the food take?
answer_variants: Could you tell me how long it takes?

questions.question_text: Ask for the bill and say how you want to pay.
questions.canonical_answer: Could we have the bill, please? I'll pay by card.
answer_variants: The bill, please — cash is fine.

questions.question_text: Imagine the bill is higher than you expected. Ask about it.
questions.canonical_answer: Excuse me, could you check the bill? I think there is a mistake.
answer_variants: What is this extra charge for?

topics.persona_en: Rustam, a waiter in a small, busy city cafe
topics.setting_en: lunch rush, most tables full, you are on your feet

material.rule_uz: Siz yo'lovchisiz, AI haydovchi. U manzilni so'raydi, narx aytadi, yo'lda gaplashadi. Siz manzilni tushuntirasiz va kelishasiz.
material.rule_ru: Вы — пассажир, ИИ — водитель. Он спрашивает адрес, называет цену, разговаривает по дороге. Вы объясняете адрес и договариваетесь.
material.usage_uz: Haydovchi manzilni birinchi martada tushunmasligi mumkin — shunda siz joyni boshqa so'zlar bilan tushuntirishingiz kerak bo'ladi: "bank yonida", "maktabdan keyin". Aynan shu qayta tushuntirish real hayotda eng ko'p kerak bo'ladigan ko'nikma.
material.usage_ru: Водитель может не понять адрес с первого раза — тогда придётся объяснить место другими словами: «рядом с банком», «после школы». Именно это переобъяснение и есть навык, который в жизни нужен чаще всего.

examples.en: Could you take me to the airport?
examples.ru: Вы можете отвезти меня в аэропорт?

examples.en: It's next to the bank, behind the school.
examples.ru: Это рядом с банком, за школой.

examples.en: How much is it to the centre?
It depends on the traffic, I think.

chunks.translation_ru: не могли бы вы сбавить скорость

questions.question_text: Imagine you get into a taxi. Tell me where you want to go.
questions.canonical_answer: Could you take me to the airport, please?
answer_variants: I need to go to the train station.

questions.question_text: Imagine I don't know the address. Describe the place another way.
questions.canonical_answer: It's next to the bank, behind the big school.
answer_variants: It is near the market, opposite the pharmacy.

questions.question_text: Ask about the price before we start.
questions.canonical_answer: How much is it to the centre?
answer_variants: What is the price to the airport?

questions.question_text: Imagine the price is too high. Say something.
questions.canonical_answer: That's too expensive — could you do it for less?
answer_variants: Last time I paid much less than that.

questions.question_text: Ask me how long the ride will take.
questions.canonical_answer: How long will it take to get there?
answer_variants: Could you tell me how long the ride is?

questions.question_text: Imagine the driver is going too fast. Tell him politely.
questions.canonical_answer: Could you slow down a little, please?
answer_variants: Please drive a bit slower.

questions.question_text: Tell me to stop before the corner.
questions.canonical_answer: Just here is fine, before the corner.
answer_variants: Could you stop in front of that shop?

questions.question_text: Imagine you have no small money. Sort out the payment.
questions.canonical_answer: I only have a big note — can you give me change?
answer_variants: Can I pay by card instead?

material.rule_uz: Siz xaridorsiz, AI sotuvchi. Siz olgan narsani qaytarmoqchisiz: nima bo'lganini tushuntirishingiz va nima kutayotganingizni aytishingiz kerak.
material.rule_ru: Вы — покупатель, ИИ — продавец. Вы хотите вернуть покупку: нужно объяснить, что случилось, и сказать, чего вы ждёте.
material.usage_uz: Bu vaziyat o'tgan zamon ustida turadi: qachon oldingiz, nima bo'ldi, cheki bormi. Sotuvchi darhol pul qaytarmaydi — siz o'z fikringizni yumshoq, lekin qat'iy aytishingiz kerak bo'ladi.
material.usage_ru: Эта ситуация держится на прошедшем времени: когда купили, что случилось, есть ли чек. Продавец не сразу вернёт деньги — придётся мягко, но твёрдо настоять на своём.

examples.en: I bought this shirt yesterday, but it doesn't fit.
examples.uz: Bu ko'ylakni kecha oldim, lekin o'lchamim emas.
examples.ru: Я купил эту рубашку вчера, но она не подходит.

examples.en: I didn't open the box.
To be honest, it stopped working after two days.
examples.uz: Rostini aytsam, ikki kundan keyin ishlamay qoldi.
examples.ru: Честно говоря, через два дня он перестал работать.

examples.en: I'd like a refund, please.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are at the counter. Explain why you came back.
questions.canonical_answer: I bought this shirt yesterday, but it doesn't fit.
answer_variants: I got this phone last week and it stopped working.

questions.question_text: Tell me when you bought it and how you paid.
questions.canonical_answer: I bought it on Saturday and I paid by card.
answer_variants: I got it two days ago, in cash.

questions.question_text: Imagine I ask if you used it. Answer me.
questions.canonical_answer: No, I didn't use it, I only opened the box.
answer_variants: I didn't wear it, the label is still on.

questions.question_text: Tell me what exactly went wrong with it.
questions.canonical_answer: To be honest, it stopped working after two days.
answer_variants: The zip broke the first time I wore it.

questions.question_text: Say what you want: your money back or another one.
questions.canonical_answer: I'd like a refund, please, not an exchange.
answer_variants: Can I exchange it for a bigger size?

questions.question_text: Imagine I say returns are not possible. Insist politely.
questions.canonical_answer: I understand, but the shirt was faulty when I bought it.

questions.question_text: Imagine you lost the receipt. Explain the situation.
questions.canonical_answer: I don't have the receipt, but I paid by card — you can check it.
answer_variants: I lost the receipt, but I have the message from the bank.

questions.question_text: Ask how long the refund will take.
questions.canonical_answer: How long will the refund take?
answer_variants: Could you tell me when I get the money?

material.rule_uz: Siz bemorsiz, AI shifokor. U nimadan shikoyat qilayotganingizni, qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini so'raydi va maslahat beradi.
material.rule_ru: Вы — пациент, ИИ — врач. Он спрашивает, что вас беспокоит, как давно это длится, и даёт рекомендации.
material.usage_uz: Shifokorning eng birinchi savoli har doim MUDDAT haqida: "How long have you had it?" Shuning uchun bu vaziyat "for" va "since" ustida ishlaydi — "for three days", "since Monday".
material.usage_ru: Первый вопрос врача всегда о СРОКЕ: «How long have you had it?» Поэтому эта ситуация тренирует «for» и «since» — «for three days», «since Monday».

examples.en: I've had a headache for three days.
examples.ru: У меня болит голова уже три дня.

examples.en: It started on Monday, after work.
I haven't slept well since then.
examples.ru: С тех пор я плохо сплю.

examples.en: You'd better rest for a couple of days.
examples.uz: Bir-ikki kun dam olsangiz yaxshi bo'ladi.

answer_variants: My back has hurt since last week.

questions.question_text: Tell me exactly when it started.
questions.canonical_answer: It started on Monday, after work.

questions.question_text: Tell me how it has changed since then.
questions.canonical_answer: It has got worse since Tuesday.
answer_variants: I haven't slept well since then.

questions.question_text: Tell me what medicine you have taken.
questions.canonical_answer: I've taken paracetamol twice, but it didn't help much.
answer_variants: I haven't taken anything yet.

questions.question_text: Imagine I ask about your sleep and food. Answer me.
questions.canonical_answer: I've slept badly for a week and I haven't eaten much.
answer_variants: I sleep about four hours and eat once a day.

questions.question_text: Ask me whether it is serious.
questions.canonical_answer: Do you think it is serious, doctor?
answer_variants: Could you tell me what it is?

questions.question_text: Imagine I tell you to rest for a week. Explain your problem with that.
questions.canonical_answer: To be honest, I can't stop working for a week.
answer_variants: I'd rather take medicine and keep working.

questions.canonical_answer: What should I do if it gets worse?
answer_variants: Should I come back next week?

topics.setting_en: a short appointment, ten minutes per patient

material.rule_uz: Siz mehmonsiz, AI qabulxona xodimi. Siz joylashasiz, xona haqida so'raysiz va muammo chiqsa hal qilasiz.
material.rule_ru: Вы — гость, ИИ — сотрудник на ресепшене. Вы заселяетесь, спрашиваете о номере и решаете возникшую проблему.
material.usage_uz: Bu vaziyat "there is / there are" ustida ishlaydi: xonada nima bor, nima yo'q. Xodim xonani almashtirishni taklif qilishi yoki "joy yo'q" deyishi mumkin — shunda muzokara boshlanadi.
material.usage_ru: Ситуация тренирует «there is / there are»: что есть в номере, чего нет. Сотрудник может предложить другой номер или сказать, что мест нет — и тогда начинаются переговоры.

examples.en: I have a reservation for two nights.
examples.uz: Ikki kecha uchun joy band qilganman.
examples.ru: У меня забронировано на две ночи.

examples.en: Is there wifi in the room?
There isn't any hot water in the bathroom.
I'm about to go out — could you keep my bag?
examples.uz: Hozir chiqaman — sumkamni saqlab tura olasizmi?
examples.ru: Я сейчас выхожу — можете подержать мою сумку?

questions.question_text: Imagine you are at the reception desk. Check in.
questions.canonical_answer: Good evening, I have a reservation for two nights.
answer_variants: Hello, I booked a room for tonight.

questions.question_text: Ask about what the room has.
questions.canonical_answer: Is there wifi and air conditioning in the room?
answer_variants: Are there two beds in the room?

questions.question_text: Ask about breakfast and the checkout time.
questions.canonical_answer: What time is breakfast, and when do I have to check out?
answer_variants: Is breakfast included in the price?

questions.question_text: Imagine there is no hot water in your room. Report it.
questions.canonical_answer: There isn't any hot water in my bathroom.
answer_variants: The shower doesn't work, there is only cold water.

questions.question_text: Imagine the room is noisy. Ask for another one.
questions.canonical_answer: The room is very noisy — could I have a quieter one?
answer_variants: Is there a room away from the road?

questions.question_text: Tell me you are going out and ask about your bag.
questions.canonical_answer: I'm about to go out — could you keep my bag until the evening?
answer_variants: I'm about to leave, is there a place for luggage?

questions.question_text: Ask what there is near the hotel.
questions.canonical_answer: Is there a pharmacy or a shop near the hotel?
answer_variants: What is there to see near here?

questions.question_text: Imagine you want to stay one more night. Arrange it.
questions.canonical_answer: Could I stay one more night? How much would that be?
answer_variants: I'd like to add another night, if there is a room.

topics.persona_en: Sardor, a receptionist at a mid-size hotel
topics.setting_en: late evening, one other guest waiting

material.rule_uz: Siz nomzodsiz, AI ish beruvchi. U tajribangizni, kuchli tomonlaringizni so'raydi va noqulay savol ham beradi. Siz to'liq gaplar bilan javob berasiz.
material.rule_ru: Вы — кандидат, ИИ — работодатель. Он спрашивает об опыте, о сильных сторонах и задаёт неудобный вопрос. Вы отвечаете полными предложениями.
material.usage_uz: Tajriba haqida gapirganda ikki zamon almashib turadi: umumiy tajriba — "I have worked...", aniq voqea — "In 2021 I moved...". Suhbat oxirida "I look forward to hearing from you" deyish deyarli standart.
material.usage_ru: Когда говорите об опыте, чередуются два времени: общий опыт — «I have worked...», конкретный случай — «In 2021 I moved...». В конце собеседования почти стандартно говорят «I look forward to hearing from you».

examples.en: I have worked as a driver for five years.
examples.uz: Besh yildan beri haydovchi bo'lib ishlayman.

examples.en: I've never managed a team, but I learn fast.
examples.uz: Hech jamoa boshqarmaganman, lekin tez o'rganaman.
examples.ru: Я никогда не руководил командой, но быстро учусь.

examples.en: In 2022 I moved to a bigger company.
examples.ru: В 2022 году я перешёл в более крупную компанию.

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.question_text: Imagine the interview starts. Tell me about yourself.
questions.canonical_answer: I have worked as a driver for five years and I know the city well.
answer_variants: I've been a teacher since 2019.

questions.question_text: Tell me why you left your last job.
questions.canonical_answer: I left because the company moved to another city.
answer_variants: I wanted more responsibility, so I resigned last month.

questions.question_text: Tell me about the biggest thing you have done at work.
questions.canonical_answer: I have trained four new drivers, and that was the hardest part.
answer_variants: I've organised a big event for two hundred people.

questions.question_text: Imagine I say you have no experience with our system. Answer that.
questions.canonical_answer: That's true, I've never used it, but I learn new systems quickly.
answer_variants: I haven't worked with it, but I used a similar one.

questions.question_text: Tell me about a mistake you have made and what you learned.
questions.canonical_answer: I once sent a wrong report, and since then I always check twice.
answer_variants: I've made a big mistake with a client, and I learned to ask first.

questions.question_text: Ask me two questions about this job.
questions.canonical_answer: Could you tell me about the team? And what are the working hours?
answer_variants: What would my first month look like?

questions.question_text: Tell me what salary you expect and why.
questions.canonical_answer: I expect around eight million, because I have five years of experience.
answer_variants: It depends on the responsibilities, but I have a number in mind.

questions.question_text: Imagine the interview is finishing. Close it politely.
questions.canonical_answer: Thank you for your time, I look forward to hearing from you.
answer_variants: Thanks a lot — when can I start if you choose me?

topics.setting_en: a first interview, thirty minutes, five more candidates today
